annotations.title: Repeat a scene along a line

description:
Place copies of one scene along a line in one call: fence posts, clamps, a row of windows (at most 64). Returns the created node paths and saves the scene once.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/repeat-along"}

align.description: With end + spacing: where the leftover length goes. start = first copy at start; center = leftover split; end = last copy at end.

direction.description: Instead of end: direction of the row; needs count and spacing.

end.description: Line end. With spacing: as many copies as fit; with count: count copies spread from start to end.

namePrefix.description: Copies are named <namePrefix>_<n> (default: the template file name).

parent.description: Parent for the copies; start/end/direction are in this parent's local space (same as position).

rotationDegrees.description: rotation_degrees for every copy [x, y, z].

scale.description: scale for every copy [x, y, z].

scenePath.description: Exact scene to read or change, e.g. 'res://levels/street.tscn'. It must be open in the editor (any tab).

start.description: First copy's position [x, y, z] in the parent's space.

template.description: Scene to instance for every copy, e.g. 'res://kit/pipes/wall_clamp_a.tscn'.

name: summer_repeat_along
title: Repeat a scene along a line
